desc:
🛴 Welcome to Scooter For Eggs!

  How to Play:
  🛴 Ride your scooter to the egg nests
  🥚 Steal eggs, but watch out for the police guards!
  🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare pets
  💰 Earn money from the pets in your pen
  ⬆️ Upgrade your pen and treadmill
  🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
  ✨ Unlock trails, fuse pets and rebirth for bigger rewards!

  🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players

Tags: Scooter, Kukirin, Steal an Egg, Steal
